extName.message: WholePage Shot - Full Page Screenshot to PNG & PDF

extDescription.message: Save the page you are viewing, from top to bottom, as a single image or PDF.

previewAlt.message: Reduced preview of the captured page

optPreScroll.message: Scroll to the bottom once before capturing

optPreScrollNote.message: Loads images and text that appear only as you scroll. Turning this off is faster, but blank areas may remain.

optHideFixed.message: Hide sticky headers and footers from the second tile onward

optHideFixedNote.message: Stops floating menus from appearing over and over in the finished image. Turn it off if a site does not capture well.

optIntervalNote.message: A shorter wait is faster, but Chrome limits how often a tab can be captured. Increase it if captures fail (450 is recommended).

shortcutNote.message: No shortcut is set by default. To add one, open chrome://extensions/shortcuts and assign any combination (for example Alt + Shift + S) to "Capture this whole page".

statusCopying.message: Getting the image ready to copy

statusCopied.message: Copied. You can paste it now.

noticeScaled.message: This page is very long, so it is saved at $PERCENT$% of full size.

noticeTruncated.message: The page was too long, so only part of it was captured.

errRestricted.message:
Chrome does not allow captures on this page.
This applies to the settings pages, the extensions manager and the Chrome Web Store.
Please open an ordinary website and try again.

errNotLoaded.message:
Could not reach this page.
Please reload the page and try again.

errPageSlow.message: The page does not seem to have finished loading. Please try again once it has.

errNoData.message: The captured data was not found. Please try again.

errTabSwitched.message: The window switched to another tab during the capture. Please keep that tab in front until it finishes.

errNoResponse.message: The page is not responding. Please keep the tab in front while it is being captured.

errTooLarge.message: The image was too large to write out.

errBodyMissing.message: The page content has not loaded yet.
